# GitHub-parity footnotes — implementation spec (read-only plan)

## 1. Syntax decision

**Adopt GitHub syntax exactly, no alternative:**

- Reference: `[^label]` inline, anywhere normal inline Markdown works.
- Definition: `[^label]: text` — a line whose block content starts with `[^label]:` (up to 3 leading spaces, per GitHub; continuation = following indented lines, lazily like blockquotes).
- Backlink: `↩` affordance on each definition jumping to its ref(s); multiple refs to one definition allowed and numbered (`↩1 ↩2 …` when >1, GitHub-style).
- Undefined `[^x]` (no matching definition in the note): stays literal, unstyled, unclickable.

**Rationale:** the brief demands GitHub parity; `[^…]` is unambiguous against the existing grammar — it cannot collide with `[[wiki]]` (`src/logic/markdown/mod.rs:168-196` `links()`), `[text](url)` (`web_link`, `mod.rs:154-165`), `[ ]`/`[x]` checkboxes (`boxes()`, `mod.rs:~215-229`), or `#tag` parsing. Pandoc-style inline `^[…]` would collide with checkbox-adjacent `[` parsing and has no GitHub story — rejected. "Kept as you typed them" (`book/src/writing.md:34`) is the current contract this spec replaces; `docs/design/markdown_renderer.md:130-142,199-202` already frames this as the undecided item.

**Label rules (normative for the writer):** label = 1+ chars, no `]`, no whitespace-only, no `|` (protects `tables.rs:7` `bars()` — a `|` inside a label must not split a cell). Match case-insensitively, display first-seen casing. Definitions and refs outside code spans/fences/front matter only (reuse `is_fence`, `code_block` `mod.rs:~700-730`, `front_matter`).

## 2. Data structures (new, `src/logic/markdown/mod.rs`)

1. `pub enum Link` (`mod.rs:28-33`) — add `Footnote(String)` variant carrying the normalized label. This single addition flows refs through every existing consumer: `links_and_comments()` styling, `elided()` kept-ranges, `print.rs:266` link iteration, `mouse.rs:599,684` click lookup. Everything else stays `match`-exhaustive — compiler lists the sites.
2. New per-line helpers mirroring `web_link`/`image`:
   - `pub fn footnote_ref(rest: &str) -> Option<(Range<usize>, Range<usize>, String)>` — `[^label]` at `rest` start → (whole range, label range, normalized label). Guards: not `![^…]` (image), label charset above, CODE-awareness left to caller.
   - `pub fn footnote_def(line: &str) -> Option<(Range<usize>, String)>` — definition opener after optional ≤3-space indent and after `classify` marker: returns label range + label. Continuation lines: indented non-blank lines following a def line while indented (same rule as list continuation; see `lists.rs`).
3. New document pass mirroring `index()` (`mod.rs:~860-900`) / `all_comments` (`mod.rs:~1101-1130`):
   - `pub struct FootDef { label: String, display: String /* 1-based number by first-ref order */, at: usize /* byte of def line */, refs: Vec<usize> /* bytes of each ref */ }`
   - `pub fn footnotes(text: &str) -> Vec<FootDef>` — one scan, fence/front-matter/code-block aware (same guards as `index`), numbering defs by order of first reference (GitHub numbers by first ref, not by def position). Case-insensitive label map.
   - Cheap pre-scan for the layout hot path, mirroring `count_fences_and_dollars` (`mod.rs:~84-99`): `pub fn count_footnotes(text) -> (usize /*defs*/, usize /*refs*/)` or a version hash, so `plan()` can skip recollection when untouched.

## 3. Step-by-step plan with hooks

**Step 1 — parser (`src/logic/markdown/mod.rs`).**
- `links()` (`:168-196`): add `[^label]` arm before the bare-`[` fallthrough: if `rest` starts with `[^`, find closing `]`; validate label; push `(range, Link::Footnote(label))`; advance past `]`. Must skip when preceded by `!` (image `![…](…)` path already claims `![`; ensure `![^x]` is not a footnote — check `b[i-1] != b'!'`). Unit tests beside the `links` test at `:1482-1497`.
- `links_and_comments()` (`:388-417`): new arm — `Link::Footnote(_)`: mark `[^` and `]` bytes `DIM`, label bytes `LINK` (accent + underline via `text_runs`, `layout.rs:577-592`). This is what makes refs clickable-looking and hides only the brackets off-live. Undefined refs: this per-line fn cannot know defined-ness → mark all refs `LINK` here, and let the *layout* downgrade undefined ones (Step 2). Alternative considered (doc-set threaded into `flags()/inline()`): rejected — `flags(line, from)` signature (`:519`) is called per-cell from `grid.rs` too; threading a set through all callers is invasive. Downgrade-in-layout keeps the pure layer line-local.
- `footnote_def()` + `footnotes()` as §2. Def-line styling: in the layout's per-line flag setup (`layout.rs:1566-1620`), if `footnote_def(line)` matches at/after `marker`, set `[^`, `]:` bytes `DIM`, label bytes `LINK` (clickable target for the return jump). Def body text keeps normal inline styling (refs inside def bodies must parse — GitHub allows them).

**Step 2 — editor layout (`src/views/editor/layout.rs`).**
- Cache: add `foot: Vec<FootDef>` (or `HashMap<label, def-idx>`) to the layout state next to `fences` (`:35`, `:2046`), recomputed when `count_footnotes` changes or full relayout occurs; reuse path (`plan`, `:752-790`) keeps it otherwise. **Critical:** adding/removing a *definition* changes rendering of *distant ref lines* (defined↔literal). So the per-line style id hasher (`:1526-1545`) must include defined-ness (a bool or the def count/version) in the hashed tuple, and `LayoutKey` (`:7-18`) / `Laid` (`:28-39`) gain a `foot: u64` version field — else `plan()` reuse shows stale literal/link styling. Same pattern as `dollars`/`fences` already handled there.
- Undefined downgrade: after `md::inline(line, marker, &mut flags)` (`:1596`), for each `Link::Footnote(label)` range on the line, if label ∉ cached defs, clear `LINK` on the label and `DIM` on brackets (render literal). Defined refs keep §1 styling.
- Hide gate (`:1624-1640`, `elided()` `:656-712`): extend the `kept` closure (`:670-676`) — footnote *label* ranges join `links/image/comments/callout` as kept-readable; brackets are `DIM` non-`CODE`/`QUIET` so they elide off-live automatically. Ref line `See [^1] here` (live line shows `See [^1] here`; off-live shows `See 1 here` with `1` accented/underlined). Add footnote ranges to the `hide`/`elide` flow — no gate-condition change needed (`Kind::Para|Heading|Quote|Bullet|Ordered|Task` already covers ref sites). No change to `Kind` enum.
- `subs` map (`:1683-1730`, `grid::shown/source` `grid.rs:97-121`, `Row::shown/source` `layout.rs:317-325`): elisions reuse the existing `(at, len, 0)` path — no new machinery. Round-trip invariant already tested (`:2637-2647`) — extend that test with a footnote line.

**Step 3 — navigation / backlinks (`src/views/editor/mouse.rs`, `cursor.rs`).**
- Ref → def: `mouse_down` Ctrl+click path (`mouse.rs:598-616`) already resolves `md::links(line)` under cursor and emits `EditorEvent::Open(link)`. With `Link::Footnote(label)` in that enum, add an arm *before* the generic `Open`: look up the cached def, call `self.jump(def.at, false, cx)` (`cursor.rs:36-40`, scrolls minimally into view) and set `self.revealed = None` so the def line stays rendered (note: `mouse_down` sets `revealed = Some(lr.start)` at `:627-628` — the footnote arm must run before that line or reset it after jumping).
- Def → ref (the `↩`): v1 = **no inserted glyph**. The def's label itself is `LINK`-styled and clickable: Ctrl+click on a def label jumps to `refs[0]`; repeated activations cycle `refs[i++]` (store last index in `Editor`, reset on edit). Rationale: inserting `↩` with zero source bytes via `subs` entry `(at, 0, k)` exercises an untested path in `grid::shown/source` (elision `(at,len,0)` is tested; insertion is not — see Risks). Ship clickable-label first; `↩` insertion as follow-up once `substitutions_map_both_ways` (`grid.rs:1176`) gains insertion cases.
- Hover cursor: `hand_at` (`blocks.rs:144-186`) — add footnote ranges to the pointing-hand condition alongside links/embeds (check `part_at`/link lookup used there).
- Completion (v2, optional): suggest existing labels after typing `[^`, mirroring `[[` completion and `#^` block anchors (`completion.rs:76-86,125-136`). Not required for parity v1.

**Step 4 — tables, callouts, embeds.**
- Table cells: `bars()` (`tables.rs:7`) splits on unescaped `|` outside `[[…]]`. Since labels forbid `|` (§1), no `bars()` change. Cell shaping (`grid.rs:598-641,615-632`) calls `md::flags` per cell — footnote `LINK` styling flows automatically; undefined-downgrade must also run in the grid path (share one helper `footnote_flags(line, marker, flags, &defined)` called from both `layout.rs` and `grid.rs` cell shaping).
- Callouts: `callout()` (`mod.rs:~957`) + tint logic (`layout.rs:~1610`) untouched; refs inside quote lines work as ordinary `Kind::Quote` lines.
- Code/fences/front matter: excluded by construction (layout sets `code`/`CODE`/`Meta DIM|QUIET` before `inline`; `footnotes()` skips fenced/front-matter regions). Inline code spans: `links_and_comments` currently applies `LINK` over backtick spans for URLs too (pre-existing behavior — `symbols()` checks `CODE|LINK` at `mod.rs:~790`, links don't). Match existing link behavior; do not add a CODE guard only for footnotes (would be inconsistent).

**Step 5 — PDF/print (`src/ui/print.rs`).**
- `inline()` (`:261-310`): iterate footnote refs like `Link::Wiki` (no URL push): render the label, hide brackets (`hidden[…]=true`), no `urls` entry. Definitions print in place, literally (label + body), same as their editor rendering minus interactivity. **Deliberate v1 limitation:** no collected footnote section at page/section end (reordering print flow vs. editor flow breaks "what is printed is the note as written", `writing.md` Save-as-PDF section), no internal PDF anchors (`Page.links` are `(rect, address)` web links; `platform/pdf.rs` via svg2pdf has no destination-anchor path). Document in `book/src/writing.md` limits alongside inline-formula rule. Test in `src/shell/tests/export_pdf.rs` (`a_note_is_saved_as_pdf` pattern): footnote note exports, `urls` count excludes footnotes.

**Step 6 — plain-text copy (`src/logic/sharing.rs`).**
- `inline()` (`sharing.rs:~150-236`): `[^label]` → keep literal `[^label]` (readable, re-importable); def lines kept literally. This matches "Unknown syntax stays literal" and keeps copies round-trippable. Add cases to `sharing_plain_text_rules` (`sharing.rs:243`).

**Step 7 — docs.** Update `book/src/writing.md:21-34` (remove "footnotes … kept as you typed them", document `[^label]`/`[^label]:`/backlink/`Ctrl+click` both directions) and `docs/design/markdown_renderer.md:130-142,199-202` (resolve the undecided-syntax items).

## 4. Backlink UX (normative)

- On a **reference** (rendered `1`, accented+underlined): `Ctrl+click` (existing link gesture, `writing.md:116-117`, `mouse.rs:598`) jumps to the definition line (cursor + minimal scroll via `jump(at, false)`); cursor line does *not* reveal source (plain `move_to` path, consistent with "plain cursor move does not reveal").
- On a **definition label**: `Ctrl+click` jumps to first ref; each further `Ctrl+click` on the same def cycles refs (GitHub's `↩1 ↩2` equivalent without glyph insertion). Single ref → stable ping-pong.
- Non-goals v1: hover popovers, `↩` glyph rendering, renumber-on-edit animation (numbers recompute on next layout; text never mutates — "text itself never changes" invariant from test `:2652-2668`).

## 5. Edge cases

| Case | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Undefined `[^x]` | literal, no style, no click (downgrade §3-Step 2) |
| Def without refs | rendered in place, label clickable but jump is a no-op (or jumps to itself — choose no-op + no hand cursor) |
| Multi-ref | all refs styled; def cycles through `refs` |
| Refs in tables / callouts / quotes / headings | work; labels exclude `|` so `bars()` safe; heading refs render in title runs |
| Refs in code spans/fences/front matter | inert (same as links) |
| Multi-line def bodies (indented continuations) | continuation lines part of def; first line carries label/jump |
| Nested `[^a]` inside a def body | parses as ref (GitHub-consistent); self-ref cycles: jump history is cursor-based, no loop risk |
| Duplicate `[^a]:` defs | first wins; later ones render literal-ish (second def styled but not targeted) — unit-test this |
| Label case (`[^A]` vs `[^a]:`) | match (normalize lowercase); display ref's own casing |
| Clipboard/find | operate on source bytes via `subs` round-trip — unchanged |

## 6. Risks

1. **Cross-line invalidation via reuse:** def add/remove restyles distant lines; if the footnote version is left out of `LayoutKey`/`plan()` reuse (`layout.rs:752-790,986-996,2039-2046`), stale styling persists. Mitigation: version field + hash in the per-line id (`:1526-1545`). Test: add def after refs, assert restyle without full reload.
2. **`subs` insertion (if `↩` later):** `(at, 0, k)` untested in `grid::shown/source`; elision edge maps to start (`:2638`). Keep v1 elision-only.
3. **Live-line model:** `revealed: Option<usize>` (`layout.rs:13,34`) is one line; a multi-line def reveals only its first line on click — acceptable (matches quote/list behavior), but continuation lines never show markers — fine since they have none.
4. **Table grid path:** second shaping implementation (`grid.rs:541-641`) must call the shared downgrade helper or tables disagree with body text. The existing phase-3 rule "tables keep source, no subs" (test `:2642-2646` asserts `subs == 0` on table rows) means: in tables, render refs with LINK color but *no* bracket elision. Codify that.
5. **PDF anchors:** no internal-destination support in `ui/print.rs` + `platform/pdf.rs`; collecting defs at section end would also violate WYSIWYG print. V1 prints in place.
6. **Perf:** `footnotes(text)` per keystroke is O(n); gate with `count_footnotes` cheap scan (pattern: `count_fences_and_dollars`) and only recollect when counts change or the touched region contains `[^`.

## 7. Test list (mirror existing patterns)

- `mod.rs` unit tests (next to `:1482-1497`): ref parse, def parse, image/`[x](…)` non-collision, code-span exclusion, undefined-vs-defined split, duplicate defs, case-insensitivity, multi-ref collection order, continuation lines.
- `layout.rs` `#[gpui::test]` mirroring `markers_hide_until_the_line_is_clicked_or_edited` (`:2562`): ref line renders `1`-style off-live (brackets hidden, label LINK), reveals `[^1]` on click/edit, `point_of`/`index_at` round-trip over the elided brackets, clipboard still yields source.
- Reuse test: add a definition line to a note with refs, assert ref rows restyle with only partial relayout (extends `layout_reuse_matches_full_layout` idea, `ARCHITECTURE.md` costing section).
- `grid.rs` `substitutions_map_both_ways` (`:1176`): footnote elision entries map both ways (no insertion v1).
- `sharing.rs:243` `sharing_plain_text_rules`: `[^1]` passthrough cases.
- `shell/tests/export_pdf.rs`: footnote note exports to `%PDF-`, no footnote URLs in `links`.
- New e2e (`shell/tests/`): Ctrl+click ref → cursor at def; Ctrl+click def label → cursor at ref; multi-ref cycles; undefined ref click is a no-op. Follow `export_pdf.rs` harness (`start(cx, …)`, `simulate_click` with `secondary()` modifiers per `mouse.rs:598`).
